narr: Scattered thunderstorms in advance of a frontal boundary produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of central Virginia and the Virginia northern neck.
ev: There was a partial road closure on Route 639 in the vicinity of Center Drive due to high water.
Standing water delays were reported on Route 17 and Ben Gayle Road just north of Beaverdam.
There were multiple reports of high water in the City of Richmond.
Route 634 near Newland Road was closed due to standing water.
Route 630 was closed due to standing water.
Starview Lane at Amster Road was closed due to high water.
High water was reported on the road at Route 360 and Rittenhouse Drive.
High water was reported on the road along Old Hundred Road South.
High water was reported at the intersection of Goodes Bridge Road and Elkhardt Road.
Route 3 was closed east of Montross due to flooding.
Main Street was flooded in West Point.
